title: Walk in experience
content: I feel credit needs to be given to the prompt actions taken upon a recent visit to the walk in centre. The expertise and knowledge of the nurse enabled a swift response to get me to Hospital and the necessary treatment to be given. Also upon a subsequent visit I received the same level of care. A huge thank you to the team for the outstanding care and service for all that you do.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
